title: Migrate merge, pr-open, deploy-release to contract v2
goal: Migrate plugins/tool/{merge,pr-open,deploy-release} to contract v2: result_contract:2 in manifest provides, mandatory verdict/disposition/reason in every result write, rc ∈ {0,1}, valid_verdicts enumerated, provides.role and provides.events declared, no hardcoded declared-input artifact paths in plugin code.

steps.description: Write v2 result tests for merge (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in merge-result.json on every exit path: pass (squash-merge success), pass with data.mode=pr_fallback (gate absent/fail), error on branch-is-main, error on push failure, error on gh pr create failure, error on gh pr merge failure, interrupted disposition on signal-death rc (130/143/124) from gh, unavailable when outcome is unknown post-interruption. Also assert valid_verdicts covers every emitted verdict. Tests must FAIL before step-3 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/merge/manifest.yaml: add a full `provides:` section with result_contract: 2, role: merge_executor (merge is internally dispatched but must declare a role per #1704), and events: [plugin.result]. Update valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, error] (pr_fallback outcome is verdict=pass; detail in data.mode). No router: block — T0 tool, no LLM calls; absence is the correct declaration.

Migrate plugins/tool/merge/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) Every jq result write gains result_contract:2, verdict (pass for merged/pr_fallback, error for failures), disposition (complete for known terminal outcomes, interrupted for rc=130/143/124, unavailable for unknown post-interruption state, broken for other non-zero), reason; plugin-specific fields (pr_url, pr_number, branch, issue, mode) move under data:. (b) All return 2 → return 1 (6 sites). (c) Interruption detection: wrap each gh call to capture rc; classify 130/143/124 as interrupted; for merge specifically, if gh pr merge is interrupted, disposition=unavailable since the merge may have run. (d) For declared input gate_aggregator_result: replace hardcoded `$artifacts_dir/gate-aggregator-result.json` with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback for library-call compat (pr-delivery sources merge.sh directly). Keep `$artifacts_dir/review.json` as BY PATH read (undeclared legacy per manifest comment #979). Tests from step-1 turn green.

Write v2 result tests for pr-open (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in pr-result.json on every exit path: pass (PR opened), pass (PR updated — existing PR), blocked (review verdict=block), blocked (no review signal — fail-closed), error on branch-is-main, error on push failure, error on gh pr create failure, error on gh pr edit failure, interrupted disposition on signal-death rc from gh pr create/edit, unavailable when gh pr create was interrupted mid-flight. Tests must FAIL before step-6 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/pr-open/manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 to the existing provides: section. Update valid_verdicts from [] to [pass, blocked, error]. Do NOT add a role — the manifest comment explicitly prohibits it ('Do not give it a role'); pr-open is a library tool invoked internally by pr-delivery, not stage-dispatched.

Migrate plugins/tool/pr-open/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) Every jq result write gains result_contract:2, verdict (pass for opened/updated, blocked for review-block/no-signal, error for failures), disposition (complete, interrupted, broken, unavailable as appropriate), reason; fields status/draft/branch/issue move under data:. (b) All return 2 → return 1. (c) Interruption detection for gh pr create, gh pr edit, gh pr list calls; if gh pr create is interrupted, disposition=unavailable (PR may have been created). (d) For declared input review_report: replace hardcoded `$artifacts_dir/review-report.json` with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback. Keep `$artifacts_dir/review.json` as BY PATH read (undeclared legacy). Tests from step-4 turn green.

Write v2 result tests for deploy-release (TDD red step). Assert result_contract=2, verdict, disposition, reason in deploy-result.json on every exit path: deployed (dry_run), deployed (real tag+push success), error on git tag failure, error on git push failure, error on state_file absent, interrupted disposition on signal-death rc from git tag (130/143/124), unavailable if git push was interrupted (tag may already be on remote). Tests must FAIL before step-9 is implemented.

Update plugins/tool/deploy-release/manifest.yaml: add result_contract: 2 to the existing provides: section. valid_verdicts [deployed, error] is already correct — no change. role and events are already declared — no change.

Migrate plugins/tool/deploy-release/plugin.sh to contract v2. (a) All jq result writes gain result_contract:2, disposition, reason; verdict already present on most paths — verify all paths have it and add where missing (state_file absent path). plugin-specific fields (tag, pr_url, mode) move under data:. (b) The one return 2 (state_file absent) → return 1. Verify no other rc=2 paths. (c) Interruption detection: git tag rc=130/143/124 → disposition=interrupted; git push interrupted → disposition=unavailable (tag may have reached remote, rolled-back local tag annotation is insufficient); other → disposition=broken. (d) For declared input pr_url: replace hardcoded `$artifacts_dir/pr-url.txt` with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS jq read plus artifacts_dir fallback. Tests from step-7 turn green.

Update existing tests that assert v1 result shapes for these three plugins, then run the full test suite. Specifically: update pr-open-zero-commits-halts-test.sh to also assert result_contract=2 and verdict in pr-result.json; update pr-open-advisory-review-test.sh for v2 result fields; update template-merge-policy-test.sh if it asserts merge-result.json shape. Run `npm test` and fix any regressions. All new tests from steps 1, 4, 7 must be green. State the red step in the PR body (the assertion and how it failed before the fix).

notes:
PRIMARY OUTPUTS: All three manifests already declare primary: true on their main output (merge_result, pr_url, deploy_result). No step is needed to add primary declarations — the acceptance criterion is satisfied as-is.

ROUTER BUDGETS: All three are T0 tools with no LLM calls. Existing v2 T0 manifests (mutation-gate etc.) carry no router: block. This plan omits router: for all three; the requirement is satisfied by absence when tier=T0.

CLEANUP (#1829): All three plugin.sh files have empty cleanup function bodies. The lifecycle.sh engine emits plugin.cleanup.absent and returns 0 when the hook is absent from the manifest. Since there are no live resources to release, the cleanup hook is intentionally absent from all three manifests — this is the correct declaration, not an omission.

NO ARTIFACT PATHS IN CODE: mutation-gate (reference v2) still constructs input paths from artifacts_dir. The acceptance criterion grep is interpreted as applying to declared input IDs only, not legacy BY PATH reads. This plan replaces the declared-input path constructions (gate-aggregator-result.json, review-report.json, pr-url.txt) with ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS reads plus an artifacts_dir fallback. The fallback is necessary for library-call mode: pr-delivery sources merge.sh and pr-open.sh directly without going through lifecycle.sh dispatch, so ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS is not set in that call path. If the acceptance grep matches the literal filename strings (not just the variable), the fallback must be retained so library-call compat still works; if the grep must produce zero matches unconditionally, pr-delivery would need updating to set ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS before sourcing — that is out of this issue's scope and should be flagged.

MERGE VALID_VERDICTS: Current code uses status=pr_fallback. v2 maps this to verdict=pass, data.mode=pr_fallback. If downstream (pr-delivery or the engine) depends on the string 'pr_fallback' as a verdict value, add it to valid_verdicts; the current plan does not because no consuming code was found checking for it as a verdict.

PR-OPEN ROLE CONSTRAINT: The manifest comment explicitly prohibits adding a role to pr-open. This plan honours that constraint. The issue's provides.role acceptance criterion is satisfied for merge (added in step-2) and deploy-release (already present); pr-open's constraint is the documented exception.

INTERRUPTION FOR OUTWARD-FACING ACTIONS: When gh pr create or git push returns a signal-death rc, this plan emits disposition=unavailable without attempting a remote-state probe. A remote probe (additional gh/git call) is not specified and is itself interruptible. If the issue requires a probe, that is additional scope beyond what the acceptance criteria describe.

DEPLOY-RELEASE DRY_RUN: The dry_run path currently does not call git/gh so interruption is not relevant; disposition=complete is correct for that path.

ASSUMPTION: ZBUILD_STAGE_INPUTS format is a JSON object with an .inputs key whose values are resolved file paths — consistent with how lifecycle.sh populates it and how mutation-gate-style v2 inputs would be read. If the format differs, step-3/6/9 implementation must adapt accordingly.
